headline:
Real-time context monitoring.
Inside your editor.
tagline: Track token budgets with real tokenizers, score tab relevance, and manage context — a VS Code sidebar, MCP server, and CLI that pays for itself.

features.name: Token Budget Dashboard
features.description: Activity bar sidebar panel showing real-time token usage, budget meter, per-file breakdown, and active tokenizer info.

features.name: @tokalator Chat Participant
features.description: Eleven chat commands for inline budget management directly in Copilot Chat.

features.name: Tab Relevance Scoring
features.description: Ranks open tabs by relevance using import analysis, path similarity, edit recency, and diagnostics.

features.name: Model-Specific Tokenizers
features.description: Real BPE tokenizers per provider — Claude BPE for Anthropic, o200k_base for OpenAI. No more guessing at 4 chars per token.

features.name: 14 Model Profiles
features.description: Built-in profiles for Opus 4.6, Sonnet 4.5/4, Haiku 4.5, GPT-5.2, GPT-5.2 Codex, GPT-5.1, GPT-5 Mini, GPT-4.1, o3, o4-mini, Gemini 3 Pro/Flash, Gemini 2.5 Pro. Context windows and rot thresholds auto-configured.

features.name: Context Rot Warnings
features.description: Warns when conversation turns exceed the model's threshold. Each model has its own rot limit based on benchmarks.

features.name: Pinned Files
features.description: Pin important files so they are always treated as high-relevance in context scoring.

features.name: Instruction File Scanner
features.description: Finds all instruction files in your workspace (.instructions.md, .prompt.md, AGENTS.md, .cursorrules) and counts their real token cost.

features.name: Next Turn Preview
features.description: See estimated token cost of your next message before sending. Dashboard shows a live preview box with growth projections and overflow warnings.

features.name: Session Management
features.description: Track per-turn context growth with compaction analysis. Reset sessions, save summaries, and see last session stats on activation.

features.name: MCP Server for Claude Code
features.description: Brings real Claude BPE token counting into Claude Code and any MCP-capable agent via stdio transport. Four tools: count_tokens, estimate_budget, preview_turn, list_models. Zero API calls — fully offline.
features.command: claude mcp add --transport stdio tokalator -- node tokalator-mcp/build/index.js

features.name: CLI — tokalator count, budget, preview, models
features.description: Standalone terminal tool for non-VS Code workflows. Count tokens in files, get full budget breakdowns, preview next-turn cost, and list Claude model profiles — all from the command line.
features.command: npm install -g . (from tokalator-mcp/) · tokalator count src/main.ts · tokalator budget src/**/*.ts

settings.description: AI model to calculate context budget against. Sets tokenizer, context window, and rot threshold automatically.
Tabs below this relevance score are marked as distractors (0–1)
Override context window size in tokens. Leave at default to use the selected model's window.
Warn about context rot after this many chat turns

architecture.purpose: Subscribes to editor events, builds context snapshots, manages pinned files and model selection
Real BPE tokenizers — Claude BPE for Anthropic, o200k_base for OpenAI, heuristic fallback for Gemini
Scores tabs 0–1 based on language, imports, path, recency, diagnostics
Exposes count_tokens, estimate_budget, preview_turn, list_models to Claude Code via stdio MCP transport. Also ships a standalone CLI binary: tokalator count, budget, preview, models.

tokenizers.models: GPT-5.2, GPT-5.2 Codex, GPT-5.1, GPT-5 Mini, GPT-4.1, o3, o4-mini

source.title: Build from Source
source.command:
git clone https://github.com/vfaraji89/tokalator.git
cd tokalator/tokalator-extension-vs
npm install
npm run compile

cli.title: CLI (npm)
steps: cd tokalator/tokalator-mcp && npm install && npm run build
cli.command:
tokalator count src/main.ts
tokalator budget src/**/*.ts
tokalator preview 42000
tokalator models

mcp.title: MCP Server (Claude Code)
steps: claude mcp add --transport stdio tokalator -- node tokalator-mcp/build/index.js
In Claude Code: /mcp → verify tokalator is listed
mcp.command: claude mcp add --transport stdio tokalator -- node tokalator-mcp/build/index.js
